detection: schema must equal planha-canonical-architecture/3.1 and include a valid planha-architectural-text-evidence/1.0 contract
unaffected_claims: physical-space polygon independently proven without text
portal/access evidence independently proven without text
strategy: Regenerate exact text evidence and revalidate only affected claims. Mark dependent snapshots stale until validation succeeds.
review_rebinding: Never copy review authority. Re-resolve the exact occurrence and require all 3.1 binding fingerprints to match.
rollback: Revert the stacked implementation PR. Preserve 3.1 artifacts as unsupported by 3.0 rather than projecting their authority backward.
